sources.title: Destinations available visa-free, visa on arrival, or by eVisa to ROC nationals
sources.publisher: Bureau of Consular Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of China (Taiwan)
sources.officialityEvidence: BOCA's live official PDF is a current outbound travel-convenience list for ROC nationals. It is not an operative destination-law or pair-specific issuance schedule, so it is not used to normalize any listed route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: 國人可以免簽證、落地簽證及電子簽證前往之國家與地區
